shared_elements: row of three arched/semicircular 'handbag'-like objects along the upper edge
small quadruped animals standing above the arched shapes
horizontal band of repeated short strokes/zigzag pattern below the top register
large bird in profile with outstretched wing
smaller crouching animal figures in registers
figures carved in low relief against a plain field
long-necked bird in profile in the lower zone
justification: Both surfaces show the same highly distinctive scheme: a top register of three arched 'handbag' forms each surmounted by a small quadruped, a horizontal band of repeated strokes beneath, and below it registers of low-relief animals dominated by a large bird with an outstretched wing plus snakes and a long-necked bird, all in the same flat, outline-with-plain-infill relief convention on a broad rectangular pillar face. The only differences are in which subsidiary creatures are visible from each viewpoint and the amount of the lower field exposed, not in the iconographic programme itself.
